name: THE LIBRARY
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: A city's main library is open stacks (rows of steel shelving taller than a man), reading rooms of long tables, study carrels, the card catalogue's cabinets, the circulation desk by the doors.
Without heat or power, paper is fuel: a library is where a winter's fires come from.
On house tiles a row of stacks is a tile you cannot stand on; the gaps between rows are the fight.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (library_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The library is its own map kind and its cell is the library: every fight there is fought inside it (measured first at eight in ten: the alpha's one library cell rolled the street on every run, so on the alpha he would never have met it; the home center's call).
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The library's wall: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The library's carpet, worn to the backing in the aisles: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

stacks.effect: A row of steel stacks, taller than a man, half its books burned for heat: no way through, no sight through. [bb] its palisade.

endshelf.effect: The low shelf at a row's end: low cover, and the way round the row.

heap.effect: Books pulled down in a heap, kept for the fires: low cover, and slow going (3 AP). [bb] its brush.
heap.say: A heap of books: low cover, slow going.

table.effect: A long reading table on its side: cover.

carrel.effect: A study carrel, its walls high: cover.

catalogue.effect: The card catalogue's cabinets, drawers pulled for kindling: nobody stands there; cover beside them. [bb] its wall.

readers.effect: Microfilm readers on their stands, dead: low cover.

fire.effect: A fire of books somebody keeps in a steel bin. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire of books: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The library's doors, open: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in library_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: one floor; the stacks are not climbed on house tiles.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the library's dropped ceiling, soot-stained over the fires, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the hospital's grid).
